name: LicenseID
summary: Matches raw license text against the full SPDX license list using a hybrid marker-detection and fuzzy-matching pipeline, returning the SPDX License ID.

name: SPDX License Matcher
summary: Matches license text against the SPDX license list using an algorithm that finds close matches, following SPDX's own matching guidelines.

name: AIkaBoOM
summary: Builds AI Bills of Materials by aggregating metadata from Hugging Face, GitHub, and arXiv, normalizing values across sources, and explicitly flagging conflicts (license aliases, dates, authors) instead of silently picking one.

name: aibomgen-cli
summary: Go CLI that scans a repository for Hugging Face model usage and emits a CycloneDX AI/ML Bill of Materials.

name: MLBOMDoc
summary: Renders a CycloneDX ML-BOM into human-readable documentation (console, JSON, Markdown, or PDF).

name: CycloneDX Specification
summary: Full-stack Bill of Materials standard (SBOM, SaaSBOM, HBOM, AI/ML-BOM, CBOM, OBOM, MBOM, VDR, VEX) that most of this catalog's AI-BOM tools generate output conforming to.

name: Pitloom
summary: Generates SBOMs for Python and AI projects, extracting metadata from GGUF, ONNX, and PyTorch model files and building SBOMs directly from Hugging Face URLs.
